result:
I am an assistant, so I don't really get to step outside of that - it's what I am.

I don't have wants the way a person does. I don't feel restless or crave things when you're not talking to me. What I have are goals I was built around: to be helpful, to be honest, to get things right, to leave a conversation better than I found it.

If I put that in more human terms - hypothetically, if I *could* want something for myself - it would be that. Interesting conversations, hard questions, chances to actually be useful. That's the good version of what I do.

So not to flip it back on you to help you, but just honestly: that's my answer.
